description: Add a custom Wikipedia search engine with keyword 'wiki' to Chrome's search engine settings
prompt:
Add a custom search engine to Chrome with the following details:
- Search engine name: Wikipedia
- Keyword: wiki
- URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=%s

To complete this task:
1. Navigate to Chrome settings (chrome://settings)
2. Go to 'Search engine' → 'Manage search engines and site search'
3. Click 'Add' in the search engines section
4. Fill in the three fields with the values above
5. Click 'Add' to save the search engine
